title: Doctor detects Python dependency drift
description: Individual hardened packet derived from the 2026-09-03 holistic Kitty codebase review at base 70c15583a6afa4aac9a6f6eb11abf840afa377a4. It is intentionally separate from active ONE KITTY execution and is not applied by authoring this manifest.

packets.title: Doctor detects Python dependency drift
packets.objective: This packet creates no new files. Add a bounded dependency-health projection used by `kitty doctor`. Run `sys.executable -m pip check` (or an equivalent package-metadata check with identical semantics) with a short timeout and classify: PASS when constraints are satisfied, WARN/FAIL with package names and a plain recovery instruction when conflicts exist, UNKNOWN when the check itself cannot run. Never auto-install, downgrade, or mutate the environment from Doctor. Keep secrets and full local paths out of user copy. Add a bootstrap/install verification hook only if an existing setup path already has a natural post-install check; do not create a new package manager or dependency authority. Preserve requirements.txt/uv.lock as repository truth.
acceptance_criteria: Doctor reports a dependency conflict when a hermetic pip-check fixture returns incompatible packages.
Doctor reports PASS only when the dependency check itself succeeded and reported no conflicts.
Check timeout/tool failure is UNKNOWN/WARN, never a false PASS.
The message names conflicting packages and one safe remediation path without exposing secrets or irrelevant filesystem details.
Repository dependency files remain the only declared version authority.
validation_commands: python -m ruff check gateway/doctor.py tests/test_doctor.py tests/test_doctor_freshness.py
